title: Relay Load Capacity
functionSignature: def relay_load_capacity(loads: list[int], rounds: int) -> int:
statement:
A relay processes a log of positive integer loads in arrival order. In one round it processes one nonempty contiguous section of the log, and the sum of that section cannot exceed its capacity. Every load must be processed exactly once; loads cannot be split or reordered. The same capacity is used in every round. Return the smallest integer capacity that allows the entire log to be processed in at most rounds rounds. You may use fewer rounds than allowed.

For loads [4, 2, 7, 3] and rounds = 2, capacity 10 works by processing [4, 2] and [7, 3]. Capacity 9 requires three rounds, so return 10. If the round allowance exceeds the number of loads, processing each load separately is allowed.
constraints:
1 <= len(loads) <= 100000
1 <= loads[i] <= 1000000
1 <= rounds <= 100000
Return an integer capacity, which may exceed 32-bit range. Aim for O(n log(sum(loads))) time and O(1) extra space.

examples.explanation: Two sections with sums 6 and 10 suffice; capacity 9 does not.
Use three rounds, fewer than the five allowed.
All loads must fit together in one round.
